name: formal_claims passed → proof_readiness implementation-ready marker
description: OpenSpec SDD task 2.3 / ADR-055 D4 — consumes the analyzer's exact route summary on the run entity. When formal_claims.status=passed, this rule releases the run to the future dev-from-task slice by stamping proof_readiness.route=implementation and proof_readiness.implementation_ready=true. It does NOT publish a raw NATS event and does NOT spawn implementation directly; dev-from-task (P4) consumes the graph marker once that pack exists.

metadata.flow_contract: Rules consume formal_claims.route.* summary predicates emitted by analyze_proof_readiness; no wildcard predicate matching and no raw NATS subscriber.
metadata.downstream: dev-from-task P4 consumes proof_readiness.implementation_ready=true plus change.<slug>.task.*.
